study type: Cross-sectional study for prediction tool development and validation
cohort: The study included 603 pregnant women for the prediction tool development phase and 61 pregnant women for external validation.
finding: A 7-item scoring tool based on maternal and fetal characteristics was developed and validated with good predictive ability (AUC 0.813) for cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: The developed 7-item scoring tool effectively predicts cesarean section delivery based on maternal and fetal factors.
cross-section timing: Data were collected from pregnant women to predict the mode of birth.
birth_weight: Birthweight ≥ 3500g was identified as a significant predictive factor.
gest_age: Gestational age < 37 weeks was identified as a significant predictive factor.
